name: Jarred Skull
effect: 🫀^25 or Stunned.

name: Momentum Thief
effect: Opponent redirects your momentum: slides you 2 sq and you are Prone.

name: Buckled Knee
effect: 💪^💪 or Prone. 👣 halved 1 Rnd.

name: Crumpled Shield
effect: d3 Wnds.No Blocks until repaired Act(AM).

name: Crusing Blow
effect: d6 Wnds. No blocks until healing.

name: Read Like a Book
effect: Opponent gains Advantage on all rolls vs you 1-Rnd.

name: Notched Edge

name: Mud Anchor
effect: Feet sink (legs jambed) under impact: 🏃^18 or Immobilized

name: Sparks in the Eyes

name: Shoulder Pop

name: Dangerously Over-Extended

name: Butterfingers
effect: 🍀 or shield/weapon shatters, even artifact.

name: Pinned Shield
effect: Opponent pins your shield to your body: Immobilized at💪^💪

name: Shattered Grip

name: Exploit the Gap

name: Wrist Sprain
effect: d2 Wnds. Disadvantage on next Block.

effect: 🫀^16 or Disadvantage on next roll.

name: Winded

name: Lodged Missile

name: Twisted Ankle
effect: 👣 halved until ankle bound Act(AM) or healed.

name: Turned Blade

name: Inversion
effect: pushed 2 sq backward. 🏃^16 or Prone.

name: Strained Back
effect: Heavy absorb wrenches spine: 🫀^18 or Weakened.

name: Block Lock
effect: Opponent locks hilt/shield and wrenches: opponent disarms you or slides you up to 2 sq (opponent's choice).

name: Catastrophic Collapse
effect: Shield/weapon shatters destroyed (if non-artifact). d12 Wnds. Prone.
